about.title: Atascadero Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Atascadero is a community of just under 30,000 people, and a loss here is felt well beyond one household. In 2025, public records show 82 injury collisions in the city, 101 people hurt, and 2 lives lost on local roads. Those crashes cluster on El Camino Real, Morro Road, and both directions of US-101, and they tend to happen most often on Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. A wrongful death claim is a civil action, entirely separate from any criminal charges the District Attorney may pursue. It exists so a family can recover funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and compensation for the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. California limits who can bring the claim, starting with a spouse or domestic partner and children, and generally sets a two-year deadline from the date of death. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect Atascadero families with an independent attorney who works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Atascadero Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California gives standing first to a spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out who in your family is eligible before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is far shorter when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Connecting soon protects that timeline.

items.title: A civil claim, not a criminal one
items.desc: Whether or not prosecutors bring charges, your family can pursue funeral costs, lost financial support, and the loss of companionship and guidance through a separate civil action.

items.question: My family member died in a crash on US-101 near Atascadero. Does the state's involvement change the deadline?
items.answer: It can. If a government entity such as Caltrans, San Luis Obispo County, or the City of Atascadero may share responsibility, California requires a formal claim to be filed with that agency well before the usual two-year deadline. Missing that early step can close the door on part of the case, so it is worth speaking with an attorney quickly.

items.question: Who in the family is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: The law gives priority to the surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the children of the person who died. If there are none, certain other dependents and heirs may qualify. An attorney reviews your specific family situation to confirm who has standing.

items.question: What losses can be recovered, and does LawProactive charge for the connection?
items.answer: California allows recovery of funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and compensation for the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. LawProactive's connection service is free, and the independent attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery.
